summary.content:
Today's selection covers 78 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 50 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI giants' race to raise funds heats up as ChatGPT-owner plans stock market debut
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CISA gives feds 3 days to patch Check Point VPN bug exploited as zero-day
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 64 articles published in the last 24 hours

all.title: Over 20,000 Instagram accounts stolen in Meta AI support hack
all.description: Meta has revealed that 20,225 Instagram users had their accounts hijacked in a recent incident where attackers used Meta's AI-powered support system to reset passwords. [...]

all.title: Hands on with Intelligent Terminal, an AI-powered Windows Terminal
all.description: Microsoft has created an open-source fork of Windows Terminal called "Intelligent Terminal," and it allows you to use AI directly inside Terminal without interfering with the regular session. [...]

all.title: C0XMO botnet spreads via DD-WRT router flaw, kills rival malware
all.description: A new variant of the Gafgyt botnet called C0XMO is targeting DD-WRT router firmware and can move to other device types with various CPU architectures. [...]

all.title: Silent Ransom Group Hits US Law Firms in Escalating Extortion Attacks
all.description: The financially motivated group is combining vishing, IT impersonation, and in-person office intrusions to steal data and extort victims.

all.title: Two New Studies Ask: Did the iPhone Cause Birthrates to Decline?
all.description: Modern smartphones rolled out in 2007, the year that fertility rates began falling. Two studies say that is not a coincidence.
